attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"They remain a persistent thorn in the side of any local commerce.","severity":"minor","reason":"Generalises the old homestead raids into an ongoing effect on commerce that the briefing never states."},{"span":"They are currently doubling their guard costs to keep their caravans moving.","severity":"minor","reason":"Turns 'travel in pairs' into a stated fact about doubled costs and presents old news as current activity."}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"It correctly treats the week as quiet and sticks to faction counts, but the wit is thin and clichéd ('thorn in the side').
